lifeline_gs_deluxe2014.desc_zh: 回春手是帕拉德隆星上硕果仅存的医官。从火种深处来说，她是一位绝对的和平主义者，对暴力的厌恶甚至让她在救治士兵时感到不安——因为她深知，一旦将伤员治愈，他们又将被重新送回残酷的战场。然而她绝非软弱之辈；她那敏锐而务实的理性，让她能够在面对毫无生还希望、徒增痛苦的伤员时，毫不犹豫地为他们执行安乐关闭程序。

abilities.desc_en: Good Chop. Bad Chop - reused animation from Motormaster's sp1 .

abilities.desc_zh: 冲刺重击时免疫远程子弹与飞行道具；命中对手必定撕裂装甲，施加流血 (Bleed)，在 5 秒内造成 {{var_1}} 物理伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Dash Heavy Attacks are immune to projectile fire and inflict Bleed dealing {{var_1}} damage over 5 seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 对手生命值越低，抢劫造成的近战伤害越高（最多提升 60%）。对处于流血状态的敌人近战必暴。
abilities.desc_en: Deals up to 60% increased Melee Damage the lower the opponent Health is. Guaranteed Critical against Bleeding foes.

abilities.desc_zh: 抢劫的重力火炮持续扰乱敌方的招式连接，暴击命中时降低对手攻击速度与招式恢复速度 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: Graviton blasts disrupt enemy reaction timing, reducing their recovery and attack speed by {{var_2}} on Critical Hits.

abilities.desc_zh: 连击数达到 10 以上时，抢劫获得残暴 (Cruelty) 增益，攻击无法被格挡，并提升 {{var_3}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Maintaining a Combo of 10 or higher grants Cruelty, making attacks Unblockable and boosting Critical Damage by {{var_3}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 成功击倒敌人或施展重击时，从对手身上窃取 15% 能量槽并转化为自身攻击力。
abilities.desc_en: Knocking down opponents steals 15% of their Power meter and converts it into bonus Attack Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 六轮赛车形态贴地极速爆冲，造成破甲降低对手 {{var_1}} 护甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒，并施加流血在 {{var_3}} 秒内造成 {{var_4}} 伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Charges in racer mode, inflicting Armor Break reducing Armor by {{var_1}} for {{var_2}}s and Bleed dealing {{var_4}} over {{var_3}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 极速绕后连击并在零距离倾泻等离子流，对敌方施加燃烧与流血，在 {{var_5}} 秒内造成 {{var_6}} 复合伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Unleashes plasma bursts from behind, inflicting Burn and Bleed dealing {{var_6}} composite damage over {{var_5}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 致命方格旗全速狂飙碾压，自身获得残暴增益，提升 {{var_7}} 攻击力持续 {{var_8}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Drags the opponent at top speed, gaining a Cruelty buff increasing Attack by {{var_7}} for {{var_8}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时获得 {{var_4}}~{{var_5}} 初始能量与 +{{var_6}} 攻击力和护甲。仅当队伍中所有成员均具有此协同（飞虎队全员）时激活。
abilities.desc_en: Start the fight with {{var_4}}~{{var_5}} Power and +{{var_6}} Attack & Armor. Bots only benefit if all Bots on the team have this Synergy.

abilities.desc_zh: 与幻影、大黄蜂同队或对战时，获得 +{{var_7}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_7}} Critical Damage when matched with or fighting Mirage or Bumblebee.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_8}} 护甲穿透。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_8}} Armor Piercing.

abilities.desc_zh: 近战攻击散发白热聚变辐射，刀刀见血，造成辐射撕裂 (Radiation Bleed) 与重度破甲。
abilities.desc_en: Melee strikes glow with white-hot solar radiation, causing Radiation Bleed and heavy Armor Break.

abilities.desc_zh: 任何近战靠近太阳风的敌人，每秒受到灼烧伤害；且面对高敏捷侦查系时，降低对手 40% 回避几率。
abilities.desc_en: Enemies in melee proximity suffer constant radiation burn. Scout evade chances are reduced by 40%.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到致命伤害时，聚变核心爆发生命跃迁，获得 5 秒绝对无敌与 100% 生命汲取吸血！
abilities.desc_en: Upon lethal damage, his fusion core flares up granting 5 seconds of Invulnerability and 100% Life Steal!

abilities.desc_zh: 从胸口聚变核心射出超高温耀斑光束，瞬间削减敌方 {{var_1}} 护甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Fires a solar flare beam, piercing defenses and reducing enemy Armor by {{var_1}} for {{var_2}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 释放炽热日珥光环，震飞周围一切敌人并施加聚变灼烧，在 {{var_3}} 秒内造成 {{var_4}} 热能伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Unleashes a blazing coronal ring, repelling foes and inflicting Fusion Burn dealing {{var_4}} damage over {{var_3}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 以耀日神圣姿态高空俯冲轰顶，自身获得耀日增益，提升 {{var_5}} 暴击伤害持续 {{var_6}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Descends as an incarnate sun deity, gaining a Solar Surge buff increasing Critical Damage by {{var_5}} for {{var_6}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 与雷震、震天尊同队时，破甲效果提升 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Armor Piercing when teamed with Bludgeon or Megatronus.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，获得 +{{var_2}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Critical Damage when teamed with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Critical Damage.
